info.title: RAEN MCP Gateway
info.description: RAEN paid x402 services on Base (USDC). Connect over MCP streamable HTTP at /mcp with a Bearer gateway key; each tool call settles in USDC via x402. New wallets get their first call free (charge-and-rebate, net $0). Free dev key: clear https://raen-x402-quest.vercel.app.
info.x-guidance: Use the MCP transport at /mcp for all five tools. Prices per call are in each operation. First call per wallet is free.

post.summary: MCP streamable HTTP endpoint (JSON-RPC: initialize, tools/list, tools/call)
post.description: Bearer-gated MCP server. tools/call with a paid tool returns an x402 402 payment challenge (USDC on Base); settle to execute. Tools: raen_law_lookup, raen_ticker_analysis, raen_dispute_letter, raen_image_generate, raen_contract_analysis.
